description: This file defines the OutOfRangeException class, which is a custom exception used in the Apache Commons Math library to indicate that a provided argument is outside of the expected range. It extends MathIllegalNumberException and includes information about the lower and higher bounds, as well as the actual value that was out of range.

classes.name: OutOfRangeException
classes.description: Custom exception indicating a value is out of a specified range, with references to the lower and upper bounds.

methods.name: OutOfRangeException
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with specific bounds and the wrong value.

methods.name: OutOfRangeException
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a localizable specific message, bounds, and wrong value.

methods.description: Returns the lower bound associated with the exception.

methods.name: getHi
methods.description: Returns the higher bound associated with the exception.
